Class TrafficLightControlPanel

java.lang.Object
TrafficLightControlPanel
public class TrafficLightControlPanel extends Object
Control panel for managing a selected traffic light manually. Provides selective control over individual traffic light signals while maintaining junction synchronization. Supports forcing green/red states for specific signals and returning to automatic SUMO control. Manual mode is synchronized across all traffic lights at the same junction to prevent conflicts.
